payload.title: What form of store path does hyp prompt print?
payload.body: Scenario that separates the rivals: create a git worktree and a clone at other paths, run hyp prompt in each, and check that each printed path resolves to the store holding the Goal. Each rival is a commit that meets all eight lines and differs from the other only in this form. The owner does not pick between them.

why: Testable choice routed to a DesignQuestion; owner declined to choose

payload.title: Print the absolute path of the store root
payload.body: hyp prompt prints filepath.Abs of the directory holding .tree/events, as store.FindRoot returns it. It needs no git. Used from a worktree or clone at another path it prints that checkout's own path.

payload.title: Print the store path relative to the repository root; with no git toplevel, exit 3
payload.body: hyp prompt prints the store root relative to the git toplevel that holds it, so the same text names the store in any clone. With no git toplevel above the store it exits 3 (an environment problem).

payload.summary: Grill ended: one build Goal with eight lines and one DesignQuestion with two rivals (store path form). Owner files later: the placeholder issue for matching run 6's prompt, and the one-root-store issue. hyp prompt does not exist in the binary yet, so the run's /goal prompt is written by hand.
